input.answer: I didn't pick anything. I'll ask you, or the clerk at the bank, about the "כספי (שקלי)" or "אג"ח ממשלות" tracks. Those are the only ones that looked anything like a deposit, and I couldn't tell from this page if any of them is really as safe as my deposits.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row of track buttons under 'במה הכסף מושקע'
stuck.why: Most of the names mean nothing to me: 'עוקב s&p 500', 'עוקב מדדים - גמיש', 'כספי (שקלי)', 'קיימת'. I only knew 'אג"ח ממשלות', and it has just 3 tracks.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the first rows in the table
stuck.why: Many rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' where the return should be, so there was nothing to compare. The rows that did have numbers jumped from 4% to 24%, and that scared me.
It's the same table again and again, one company after another, all numbers on a black screen. I couldn't keep in my head which company was cheapest for the safe kind.
This was the one I was looking for, and it says 'עוד לא דווח' for the fees and 'פחות מ־3 שנים' for the return. There was nothing to go by.
